description: On desktop, each app window (Studio, Halonic Inbox, Halonic Messenger) may keep a short string saying what it shows, at most 2 KB, through window_content_set, and read it back at start through window_content_get, so Halonic reopens each window with what it showed (HAL-19534). Both commands take the window from the call, never from an argument, so a page only reaches its own window's string; the shell never reads it. Not the feedback, brief or quick ask windows, and local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets nothing.
